summary: Tested /terminal feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed for /api/terminal/symbols, /api/terminal/candles (tf 1m,1h,1d,1wk,1mo + invalid tf -> 400), /api/terminal/quotes (explicit symbols + default watchlist). Frontend: Seeded session_token cookie, navigated to /terminal, verified terminal-page, candle-chart, terminal-watchlist render; symbol switch via watchlist-row-AAPL updates header + price (228.38 NVDA -> 333.02 AAPL); timeframe tf-btn-1d becomes active with tfActive class; watchlist-search filters rows correctly (TSLA only).

issues: Console SVG error: 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected number, …8-11 8-11-8-11-8z' — malformed path d string in some icon on page (non-blocking cosmetic).

action_items: Investigate the malformed SVG path 'd' attribute causing a repeated console error on /terminal (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: terminal.py _get_quotes caches by exact symbols-string key — same symbol set in a different order creates separate caches (minor memory waste, not a bug).
DEFAULT_WATCHLIST is duplicated between backend terminal.py and frontend Terminal.jsx; frontend ignores /api/terminal/symbols. Consider using the API-provided list to stay in sync.
Terminal.jsx: `up` is derived from header.pct but applied to toolbar price color only — fine; search is case-insensitive, works.
test_credentials: Cookie session_token=demo_session_persistent (seeded demo user in Mongo db quantai).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend terminal endpoints are stable; yfinance is live so occasional 502 fallbacks may occur — test uses pytest.skip in that case. Frontend /terminal is protected by Emergent Google auth; seed cookie as above to bypass.
